definition: a long formal dress worn to a ball
description: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.

de.answer: Sie hält einen Blumenstrauß aus roten Rosen.
